source.title: Đáp án/transcript: TOEIC LR Collection 1 Test 6 - STUDY4

children.text: (A) Some baskets are hanging from a rack.
(B) Some boxes are piled on the floor.
(C) Some towels are stacked on shelves.
(D) A sign is leaning against a wall.
(A) A crate has been filled with bottles.
(B) Some lamps are hanging from a pole.
(C) A shopper is filling a bag.
(D) Some goods have been set out on tables.
(A) Some workers are sweeping a street.
(B) A tree is being trimmed by some workers.
(C) Some branches are being loaded onto a truck.
(D) A ladder has been leaned against a wall.
(B) They're seated across from one another.
(C) One of the men is writing on paper.
(D) One of the men is closing a binder.
Would you like this poster put in a wood frame or a metal one?
(A) We took a long walk in the woods.
(B) They'd prefer to come back tomorrow.
(C) The metal one would hold up better, I think.
When are you planning to release the new app update?
(A) Sometime in early spring, most likely.
(B) It's the most complete update we've ever shipped.
(C) You can find it in the app store.
Let me help you set up the display banner.
(A) That'd be great — I'm running a bit behind.
(B) About forty people signed up for the demo.
Did you finish trimming the booklets, or are you still cutting them?
(B) No, they're printed on glossy paper.
(C) Just a couple more to go.
When are you going to plant those flowers you bought?
(A) I haven't prepared the soil yet.
Aren't you going to the garden club's open house on Saturday?
(A) Yes, I'm really looking forward to it.
(B) They're selling plants and garden tools there.
(C) In the back courtyard, near the fountain.
There's going to be a feeding show this afternoon, isn't there?
(A) They'll show you to your seats in a few minutes.
(B) The full schedule's posted right by the main entrance.
(C) No, I already bought my tickets online.
Why don't we drive over to the training center together tomorrow morning?
(B) I've already arranged a ride with someone.
(C) It's right past the second highway exit.
The part we ordered for that customer's bike still hasn't arrived.
(A) They took the whole wheel apart.
(B) That model's fairly popular this year.
(C) I'll tell him it'll be another day.
We've run out of food for the evening feeding.
(A) There's an extra bag in my car.
(B) The new kittens are very playful.
Are you recording the vocals today, or waiting for the next session?
(A) Down the hall on the left.
(B) Yes, the record just came out.
(C) My voice isn't quite ready yet.
How long does the large-load dryer take to finish?
(C) Just under an hour, I think.
You're leading the tour for the school group tomorrow morning, aren't you?
(A) That display case arrived just last week.
(B) Everything's already printed and laid out.
(C) The gift shop restocks every afternoon.
I have a feeling the client's photos aren't back from the printer yet.
(A) The printer's right next to the front desk.
(B) Yes, please back up the files tonight.
(C) Actually, they came in first thing this morning.
Would you like your ice cream in a cone?
I hope Ms. Langford likes the tasting menu we prepared for her reception.
(B) Oh, she picked it out herself.
How's the new tablet doing since we started carrying it?
(A) Over near the front, on sale now.
(B) Yes, we ordered plenty of them.
(C) Actually, it only launched this morning.
Where do I return these rental shoes?
(A) Right over by the front entrance.
Our clinic is closing early this afternoon.
(A) No, the front door won't close all the way.
(B) Sure, just leave them by the sink.
(C) Right, I'll let the last few patients know.
How much would it cost to resole these boots?
(A) They should be ready by Friday.
(B) The resoling costs about thirty dollars.
Where can I get my parking ticket validated?
(A) Yes, I parked in the garage.
(B) The clerk at the reception desk can do that.
Do you like the new coffee machine we got?
(A) Well, it does make drinks pretty quickly.
(C) Yes, I'll get you some coffee.
Didn't Coach Delaney end practice early yesterday?
(A) The coach picks us up out front.
(B) No, she actually kept us going longer than usual.
(C) I'm hoping to practice later today.
I'm driving out to the supplier this afternoon.
(A) I'm ready to leave whenever you are.
(B) Driving there takes about an hour.
Have you tried our new moisturizer sample?
(A) Because I tried a lighter cream.
(C) No, is it a new product?
